rationale.A: 1.6 km side path beside Paciuksenkatu (50 km/h), then 180 m in traffic on Eteläinen Rautatiekatu; 7 lights
rationale.C: Same Paciuksenkatu side path, then Töölö via Arkadiankatu; no mixed traffic; 7 lights
rationale.D: Mississipinraitti shore path, shorter Paciuksenkatu side path, Baana finish; 4 lights, +2 min
rationale.E: Paciuksenkatu side path then Eino Leinon katu tram in traffic; 9 lights
rationale.F: Through Central Park (Ratsastie, Auroransilta) and Töölönlahti to Baana; barely any side path; 3 lights, +2 min
rationale.G: Mannerheimintie/Tukholmankatu side tracks with a short tram-rail carriageway; 11 lights

notes: F swaps the Paciuksenkatu side path for Central Park paths and saves 4 lights for +2 min, so it covers both cards.
